meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 通过 BGPT MCP 服务器搜索科学论文,返回每篇论文 25 个以上字段的结构化实验数据,包括方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分和结论。
howto.when: 当需要检索带具体实验细节的论文、做文献综述或系统评价,或想获取摘要之外的定量结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 CRISPR 基因编辑在人类细胞中的效率数据
say.note: 返回相关论文的结构化实验结果。

say.text: 找几篇关于肿瘤免疫治疗的定量结果和样本量文章
say.note: 可比较不同研究的方法与质量评分。

say.text: 搜索比较两种降糖药疗效的论文,要含样本量
say.note: 会返回质量评分与结论。

howto.what_en: Searches a curated database of scientific papers via the BGPT MCP server and returns structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies, including methods, quantitative results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions, with 25+ fields per paper.
howto.when_en: Triggers when searching for papers with specific experimental details, conducting literature reviews or evidence synthesis, or needing quantitative results and sample sizes not available in abstracts.

say_en.text: Search for CRISPR gene editing efficiency data in human cells
say_en.note: Returns structured experimental results from relevant papers.

say_en.text: Find articles on tumor immunotherapy with quantitative results and sample sizes
say_en.note: Compare methods and quality scores across studies.

say_en.text: Search for papers comparing two diabetes drugs, include sample sizes
